body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 9869b54f5b26dbfe904952de93c46d62ed893b6b -->
Reviewer: direct launch of the PR-reviewer (no dispatcher brief); did not write, refresh or push this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (fresh review of `9869b54f5`; the earlier collaborator review of `0099e66d4` requested changes and is not an approval of this head). All three blockers from that review are addressed by the fix commit. The PR is `MERGEABLE` (`mergeStateStatus`: CLEAN) with no open collaborator change request on this head.

Tier: process-only. This PR changes `.claude/` process files and an xtask contract test. It does not touch posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. Not a safety-tier review.

## What looks good

- One shared guard (`ownership.md`) loaded by all four dispatch skills, the coordinator, the startup relays and both agents (`coordinator.md`, `PR-reviewer.md`). The fix wires every actor the earlier review named.
- Reviewer records count only from collaborator accounts (record author and named reviewer both checked against `permissions.push`); contributor pre-checks use no record, marker or labels. This closes the blocker where any account could hold a review of any PR.
- Writer liveness keeps the existing issue-claims tests (three 48-hour tests, no new timeout), with withdrawal/release handling and explicit releases kept separate from issue claims.
- The dispatch prompts (`review-prs` step 2, delta-review briefs in `resolve-conflicts` and `merge-ready`) pass the record URL, base and starting exact head; the reviewer reads before work, re-reads before verdict/labels, and releases on completion, skip or failure.
- Refresh compile checks stay per-package with `-p`, including shared inputs such as `Cargo.lock`, never `--workspace`.
- Contract tests now pin shorter phrases; 13 pass. The tests check the published procedure, not agent compliance, and say so.
- The body has `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #3661`; the PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`; the decision file is present; the new test module carries a provenance line.
- Honest limits: the procedure is a cooperative guard, not an atomic lock; the plain-push non-fast-forward property and the race it leaves are stated.

## Results (local, worktree `cc-pr4138-review`, main `e6849c5a`)

Trial merge: clean (`git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` produced tree `2c2464c2...`, no conflicts; the local trial merge came out clean).

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask ownership_contract_tests -- --nocapture` | 13 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p xtask` (all targets) | all ok, 0 failed (lib 356 + other targets; one catalog step took ~323 s) |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | red: `clippy::needless_bool` at `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67` |
| `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` | clean |

Strict clippy is red on one unchanged file. The same `needless_bool` error is on bare main (verified unchanged in this diff — the file is identical on the PR tree and on main). It is pre-existing and does not block this PR. Allowing only that lint passes.

Build path: local worktree, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`, `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6`. No runner was used (process-file PR, and the author is not a collaborator). The runner workflow refuses process changes anyway.

## Targeted steps

- Pinning tests: `ownership_contract_tests` 13/13, plus the full `xtask` unit suite (0 failures).
- Example catalog suites: none needed — no post or toolpath change.
- Light lane: not run. The light lane covers only motion/app heavy-twin steps (`camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app`); this diff reaches no heavy or light step. Running a full release build of motion+app for this process-only change would not test the change.
- Heavy lane: not run. No `P1` under the safety floor; no heavy step exists for this diff.
- Light/heavy note: nothing red; no heavy-wave record is required.

## Requested before merge

Nothing blocking. The earlier three blockers are addressed.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The PR body and the 15:02 review-fix record name different bases (`bd467a0cc` vs `41b44176`); the merge-base with main is `e6849c5a` now. The trial merge is clean, so no effect on this review. Keep the body consistent for the next refresh.
- Base branch point and record name are informational; a base refresh without a compile re-check would need one.
- Strict clippy stays red on the pre-existing lint; not this PR's fault.
- A collaborator record was created by this review session and will be released after posting (see below). The earlier contributor pre-check record was released; no counted reviewer record is live beyond this one.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
